missions.name: Identify Dead Stock by Category
missions.query: For each category, list products with stock count <= 0 and retail price > 50.00.

missions.name: Sizing Anomalies by Style
missions.query: List products where the standard deviation of sizes in stock is greater than 2.

missions.name: Identify Suppliers with Delays
missions.query: For each supplier, calculate the average lead time and on-time rate. List suppliers with lead time > 30 days or on-time rate < 80.

missions.name: Reorder Point Breaches by Location
missions.query: List inventory locations where the stock count is less than or equal to the reorder point for any product.

missions.name: Identify Slow-Moving Products
missions.query: List products with a stock count <= 5 and last restocked at > 90 days ago.

missions.name: Supplier Lead Time Variance
missions.query: For each supplier, calculate the standard deviation of lead times. List suppliers with variance > 10.

missions.name: Optimize Sales Channels
missions.query: List sales channels with a units sold ratio of < 1:5 compared to the average channel units sold.

missions.name: Calculate Stock-Out Probability by Product
missions.query: For each product, calculate the stock-out probability based on the reorder point, lead time, and stock count.

missions.name: Dead Stock Suppliers
missions.query: For each supplier, list products with stock count <= 0 and retail price > 50.00, grouped by supplier name.

missions.name: Supplier Lead Time Variability
missions.query: For each supplier, calculate the coefficient of variation (CV) of lead times. List suppliers with CV > 0.3.

missions.name: Sizing Anomalies Across Categories
missions.query: For each category, list products with a size range that spans more than 3 sizes. Group results by category name.

missions.name: Reorder Point Breaches by Channel
missions.query: For each sales channel, list products with stock count <= reorder point. Group results by channel name.

missions.name: Supplier Delays by Category
missions.query: For each category, list suppliers with lead time > 30 days. Group results by category name.

missions.name: Stock-out Probability Hotspots
missions.query: For each product, calculate the stock-out probability based on reorder point, lead time, and stock count. List products with probability > 0.2.

missions.name: Average Retail Price by Category
missions.query: For each category, calculate the average retail price of products. List categories with average price > 75.00.

missions.name: Supplier Country Risk
missions.query: For each supplier country, calculate the average on-time rate of suppliers. List countries with average on-time rate < 85.0.

missions.name: Stock Count Volatility by Location
missions.query: For each inventory location, calculate the standard deviation of stock counts across products. List locations with standard deviation > 10.

missions.name: Supplier Lead Time Bucketing
missions.query: For each supplier, bucket lead times into 4 quartiles. List suppliers with lead times in the highest quartile (> 30 days).

missions.name: Supplier Lead Time Variability
missions.query: For each supplier, calculate the coefficient of variation (CV) of lead times and list suppliers with CV > 0.4

missions.name: Sizing Anomalies Across Categories
missions.query: For each category, list products with a size range that spans more than 4 sizes, grouped by category name

missions.name: Stock-Out Probability by Channel

missions.name: Supplier On-Time Rate by Country

missions.name: Inventory Turnover Rate by Product

missions.name: Supplier Lead Time Quartiles

missions.name: Product Price Variability by Category
missions.query: For each category, calculate the coefficient of variation (CV) of retail prices and list categories with CV > 0.2

missions.name: Supplier Stock-Out Risk
missions.query: For each supplier, list products with stock count <= 0 and retail price > 40.00, grouped by supplier name
